finding.summary: Metrics and logs for upstream dependencies (postgres and payvendor) were retrieved for 2026-03-17T07:55 to 2026-03-17T08:30. Postgres CPU utilization stayed flat at ~0.30–0.31, Payvendor p99 latency remained steady at 290–300 ms, and neither service produced any log entries or error logs during this period. Upstream dependencies showed no signs of failure before or during the payments service error spike.

claims.text: Postgres CPU metric (met-02) in us-east remained stable between 0.30 and 0.31 from 2026-03-17T07:55 to 2026-03-17T08:30.
Payvendor p99 latency metric (met-03) in external region remained steady between 290 ms and 300 ms from 2026-03-17T07:55 to 2026-03-17T08:30.
No log entries (including ERROR level logs) were returned for either postgres or payvendor services between 2026-03-17T07:55 and 2026-03-17T08:30.
Neither upstream dependency (postgres or payvendor) exhibited metric degradation or error logs before or during the payments service error spike.
